title.zh: 微软股价触及近一年高点，公司宣布计划大规模部署自有人工智能芯片
title.en: 微软股价触及近一年高点，公司宣布计划大规模部署自有人工智能芯片

current_state.zh: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI accelerator, plans to progressively shift data-center AI workloads onto its own Maia architecture at gigawatt scale to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs, with production targeted for 2027, as the stock touched a near one-year high.
current_state.en: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI accelerator, plans to progressively shift data-center AI workloads onto its own Maia architecture at gigawatt scale to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs, with production targeted for 2027, as the stock touched a near one-year high.

updates.title_zh: 微软股价触及近一年高点，公司宣布计划大规模部署自有人工智能芯片
updates.title_en: 微软股价触及近一年高点，公司宣布计划大规模部署自有人工智能芯片
updates.what_changed_zh:
微软周一公布第三代 AI 加速芯片 Maia 300，并表示计划逐步提高自研芯片在数据中心的使用比例，未来将主要依靠自研 Maia 芯片架构处理 AI 模型请求，并计划在 Maia 系列芯片上部署数吉瓦级算力，预计 2027 年投产。据 BlockBeats 援引 BIT（Bit.com）行情数据，10 月 12 日微软股价日内上涨 0.8%，触及近一年高点。

此举被视为对英伟达在 AI 基础设施领域主导地位的直接竞争动作，目标是降低微软对英伟达 GPU 的依赖。微软称 Maia 300 有望提升 AI 服务性能并降低数据中心运营成本。

每个数据中心机架可搭载 96 颗 Maia 300 芯片，是上一代 Maia 200 的两倍；微软称与 GPU 相比，其每机架 AI Token 处理量最高可达 7 倍，每兆瓦可处理的 Token 数量提升约 40%。模型训练仍将使用英伟达和 AMD 芯片；与谷歌 TPU、亚马逊 Trainium 等产品不同，微软自研加速芯片目前尚未向其他企业开放租用。Evercore ISI 分析师预计，截至 2027 年第一季度，Maia 芯片将占微软 AI 芯片支出的约 10%。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI accelerator, plans to progressively shift data-center AI workloads onto its own Maia architecture at gigawatt scale to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs, with production targeted for 2027, as the stock touched a near one-year high.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI accelerator, plans to progressively shift data-center AI workloads onto its own Maia architecture at gigawatt scale to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs, with production targeted for 2027, as the stock touched a near one-year high.
updates.background_zh: Maia 是微软自研的 AI 加速芯片系列。此前有报道称，微软正在筹备 Maia 300，并已与台积电洽谈锁定超过 30 万颗的产能，交付目标为 2027 年。微软与亚马逊、谷歌、Meta 等超大规模云厂商一样，均已宣布吉瓦级数据中心建设计划。
updates.background_en: Maia is Microsoft's in-house AI accelerator family. Prior reports said Microsoft was preparing Maia 300 and had entered talks with TSMC to secure manufacturing capacity for more than 300,000 units, with delivery targeted for 2027. Microsoft is among the hyperscalers — alongside Amazon, Google and Meta — that have announced gigawatt-scale data-center plans.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息强化了 AI 算力叙事，而这一叙事一直是 AI 相关加密资产情绪的驱动因素；同时，吉瓦级数据中心建设与加密货币市场参与者关注的电力及矿机基础设施需求存在交集。若微软的推理负载实质性转向 Maia，将影响市场对英伟达数据中心 GPU 需求的预期，而这一渠道历来会传导至包括加密资产在内的整体风险偏好。
updates.market_impact_en: The announcement feeds the AI-compute narrative that has been a sentiment driver for AI-adjacent crypto assets, and gigawatt-scale data-center buildouts overlap with power and mining-infrastructure demand that crypto market participants track. Any concrete shift of Microsoft's inference workloads onto Maia would matter for Nvidia's data-center GPU demand expectations, a channel that has historically moved broader risk sentiment including crypto.
